BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Financial Institutions, Economic Development & Trade.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring the disclosure of drug production in improved residential real property sales.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the disclosure of drug production in improved residential real property sales; and adding a new section to chapter 64.06 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 64.06 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: In the sale of residential real property, the seller of improved residential real property has an affirmative duty to inform the buyer, in writing, whether the improved residential real property being sold was ever used to manufacture illegal drugs.
